main_text.p: פיה, פוח Ch.Favilla, quòd flatu excitetur.
פחא, פח & פוחא, פיח Ch. Laqueus, Rete, Hebr. פח. Syr.
In laqueũ, ad Rom.11.9. Plur. פחין, פחי, פוחין. Affine est Græc. πάγη, vel παγίς.

פול Ch. Misceri, commisceri. Partic. פיל Mixtum, conspersum. Fœmin. פילא, Plur. פילן. In Targum solùm in hoc Participio usitatum, idq; semper præcedente ד, præterquam semel Lev.6.23. unde alii radicem fecerunt דפל. Pahel geminat. פלפל Aspergere, cõspergere, Græc. πταλωώ. Ithpah. אתפלפל Conspergi, conspergere se.
פולן Ch.Apostoli,legati, Num.16.12. in Jon. Deut.20. 10. & Exod.10.16. in eodem.

פום, פומא, פומא פם Ch. & Syr. Os, oris: & metaphoricè Acies, cùm de gladio dicitur, & variis deinceps rebus accomodatur, ut Hebr. פה. Deinde לפום, כפום Juxta, Secundum, Pro ratione, ut Hebr. לפי, כפי. Plur. פומין.
פון Ch.Certè, Utique, vocula Chaldæis familiarissima,nulli certæ Hebrææ voci respondens: semper autem aliis vocibus adjungitur, & accipienda pro ratione loci & sententiæ.
פור Hiph. הפיר Irritum fecit,Hebr. Ethpah. ... Syr. Irritari, Act.16.18. & 1.ad Cor.13.5.

page.notes: Several Hebrew and Greek words are set with vowel points and small superscript letters; the Ethpah form at the end of the Hiph. entry is partly illegible. Sigla and the dagger-like marks in the Syriac/Hebrew forms are only approximated.
